quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a liquid biopsy platform detecting cancer from a routine blood test.
quests.correctAnswer: Our liquid biopsy detects cancer from a standard blood draw - identifying tumours years before symptoms appear when treatment success rates are highest.
quests.hint: Lead with pre-symptom detection linked to survival rates.
quests.explanation: Early detection linked to survival rates is the most compelling case in oncology diagnostics.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI diagnostic imaging platform matching radiologist accuracy on chest X-rays.
quests.correctAnswer: Our AI matches board-certified radiologist accuracy on chest X-rays and delivers results in seconds - enabling rapid diagnosis in hospitals facing radiologist shortages.
quests.hint: Lead with the radiologist shortage use case.
quests.explanation: Radiologist shortage is a global crisis - AI that fills the gap has an immediate and obvious deployment case.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a portable point-of-care diagnostic device for low-resource clinical settings.
quests.correctAnswer: Our device runs laboratory-grade blood tests in any clinical setting without lab infrastructure - bringing diagnostic precision to remote clinics and field hospitals.
quests.hint: Lead with lab precision without lab infrastructure.
quests.explanation: Lab-grade precision without the infrastructure is the core health equity pitch for point-of-care diagnostics.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a teledermatology platform connecting patients with dermatologists via photo consultation.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform sends a photo of your skin concern to a certified dermatologist who responds with a diagnosis and treatment plan within four hours - no appointment wait.
quests.hint: Lead with the four-hour response versus the typical wait.
quests.explanation: Four hours versus weeks for a dermatology appointment is an immediately understood improvement in access.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a mental health teletherapy platform with same-week appointment availability.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform offers same-week therapy appointments with licensed therapists - because mental health crises cannot wait months for a traditional appointment slot.
quests.hint: Lead with the crisis urgency argument.
quests.explanation: Timing mental health access to need rather than availability is the most patient-centred telehealth pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a remote patient monitoring platform for post-surgical recovery at home.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform monitors vital signs wound healing and medication adherence at home after surgery - enabling safe early discharge and freeing hospital beds for those who need them.
quests.hint: Lead with the safe early discharge benefit.
quests.explanation: Safe early discharge helps patients recover at home while reducing hospital costs - a dual benefit.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital CBT platform delivering cognitive behavioural therapy at population scale.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform delivers clinically validated cognitive behavioural therapy programmes digitally - bringing evidence-based mental health treatment to people who cannot access in-person therapy.
quests.hint: Lead with the clinically validated credential.
quests.explanation: Clinical validation is the critical differentiator between serious digital therapeutics and the wellness app market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI mental health companion providing between-session support for therapy patients.
quests.correctAnswer: Our AI companion supports therapy patients between sessions - reinforcing therapeutic exercises catching early relapse signals and reducing the dangerous gap between clinical contacts.
quests.hint: Lead with the between-session gap as the problem.
quests.explanation: Between-session support addresses the most dangerous gap in outpatient mental health care.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace mental health programme integrating therapy coaching and peer support.
quests.correctAnswer: Our workplace programme integrates professional therapy peer networks and evidence-based coaching into one employer benefit - addressing mental health at every level of need.
quests.hint: Lead with the spectrum of need covered.
quests.explanation: Meeting mental health needs across the full spectrum from resilience to crisis is a comprehensive employer proposition.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a robotic exoskeleton enabling stroke patients to relearn walking faster.
quests.correctAnswer: Our exoskeleton guides stroke patients through thousands of repetitive walking cycles per session - retraining the neural pathways that control movement faster than any conventional physiotherapy.
quests.hint: Lead with the neural pathway retraining mechanism.
quests.explanation: The neuroscience mechanism gives clinical credibility to the rehabilitation claim.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an at-home physiotherapy platform with AI movement analysis via phone camera.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform uses your phone camera to analyse exercise form during physiotherapy sessions at home - providing the same corrective feedback as a clinic without the travel or cost.
quests.hint: Lead with the clinic-quality feedback at home.
quests.explanation: Clinic-quality feedback at home eliminates the geographic and cost barriers to physiotherapy adherence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a virtual reality pain management platform for chronic pain patients.
quests.correctAnswer: Our VR platform reduces chronic pain perception through immersive experiences - clinically proven to reduce pain medication dependence in patients who have tried everything else.
quests.hint: Lead with the medication dependence reduction.
quests.explanation: Reducing pain medication dependence through a non-pharmacological intervention is a compelling clinical and social pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a consumer genomics platform interpreting genetic data for actionable health insights.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform translates your raw genetic data into personalised health action plans - what to eat how to train and which conditions to screen for based on your specific DNA.
quests.hint: Lead with the translation from data to action.
quests.explanation: Translation from raw data to specific actions solves the main problem with genomics - knowing what to actually do.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a pharmacogenomics testing service matching patients to the right medication.
quests.correctAnswer: Our test shows which medications your body processes well and which are likely to cause side effects - before you take a single dose and experience something harmful.
quests.hint: Lead with the before-the-dose safety.
quests.explanation: Testing medication suitability before administration prevents harmful side effects and ineffective treatments.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a genetic counselling platform connecting patients with certified counsellors online.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides on-demand video consultations with certified genetic counsellors who explain what test results mean - without the multi-month hospital appointment wait.
quests.hint: Lead with the multi-month wait elimination.
quests.explanation: Eliminating the multi-month wait for genetic counselling is an immediate quality-of-care improvement.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI drug discovery platform identifying novel candidates faster than traditional methods.
quests.correctAnswer: Our AI identifies drug candidates by screening billions of molecular combinations in weeks rather than years - compressing pharmaceutical discovery dramatically.
quests.hint: Lead with the weeks versus years compression.
quests.explanation: Weeks versus years in drug discovery directly translates to lives saved and development costs reduced.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a clinical trial patient matching platform reducing recruitment time by sixty per cent.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform matches eligible patients to relevant clinical trials automatically - cutting recruitment time by sixty per cent and enabling faster drug approvals for everyone.
quests.hint: Lead with the recruitment time reduction.
quests.explanation: Clinical trial recruitment is consistently the longest bottleneck in drug approval - solving it is immediately valuable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital biomarker platform identifying treatment response from wearable sensor data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform analyses wearable data to identify biomarkers that predict which patients will respond to specific treatments - personalised medicine at genuine clinical scale.
quests.hint: Lead with the treatment response prediction.
quests.explanation: Predicting treatment response before administration is the practical implementation of personalised medicine.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a medical-grade wearable continuously monitoring twelve vital signs.
quests.correctAnswer: Our medical-grade wearable continuously monitors twelve vital signs simultaneously - the level of physiological detail previously only available in hospital intensive care units.
quests.hint: Lead with the ICU-level data in everyday life.
quests.explanation: ICU-level continuous monitoring outside the hospital is the most ambitious positioning in consumer health tech.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an ECG wearable detecting atrial fibrillation in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our wearable detects atrial fibrillation the moment it begins and alerts both the patient and their cardiologist instantly - catching the arrhythmia that causes one in three strokes.
quests.hint: Lead with the stroke causation statistic.
quests.explanation: Linking detection directly to stroke prevention is a life-safety statistic with immediate clinical impact.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart insulin delivery wearable with automated dose adjustment for type one diabetes.
quests.correctAnswer: Our wearable monitors glucose continuously and adjusts insulin delivery automatically - functioning as an artificial pancreas that manages type one diabetes so the patient no longer has to.
quests.hint: Lead with the artificial pancreas positioning.
quests.explanation: Artificial pancreas framing captures the transformative impact on type one diabetes management.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a femtech platform delivering complete end-to-end menopause care.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides menopause patients with specialist clinicians personalised hormone therapy and peer community support - the only complete menopause care pathway in one place.
quests.hint: Lead with the complete pathway claim.
quests.explanation: Fragmented menopause care is a documented failure - a complete pathway is the differentiation the market needs.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fertility tracking device using continuous temperature and heart rate data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our device tracks basal temperature and heart rate continuously to predict fertile windows with clinical accuracy - more reliable than any manual temperature chart.
quests.hint: Lead with clinical accuracy versus manual methods.
quests.explanation: Clinical accuracy over manual methods is the key credibility claim that distinguishes medical devices from consumer apps.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a maternal mental health platform supporting mothers through prenatal and postnatal periods.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides mental health screening peer support and professional therapy throughout pregnancy and the first year of parenthood - covering the most vulnerable mental health window.
quests.hint: Lead with the vulnerable window framing.
quests.explanation: Framing perinatal mental health as the most vulnerable window creates urgency and clinical justification.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI care planning platform for complex elderly patients with multiple conditions.
quests.correctAnswer: Our AI generates personalised care plans for elderly patients with multiple conditions - coordinating between GPs specialists and carers to deliver coherent joined-up care.
quests.hint: Lead with the joined-up care coordination.
quests.explanation: Lack of care coordination is the primary cause of poor outcomes in complex elderly patients.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fall prevention wearable for elderly people living independently.
quests.correctAnswer: Our wearable detects the gait changes that precede falls weeks in advance - alerting families and care teams before an elderly person falls rather than after.
quests.hint: Lead with the pre-fall detection.
quests.explanation: Pre-fall rather than post-fall detection is the profound shift that makes this device genuinely preventive.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a social prescribing platform connecting lonely elderly patients with community activities.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform enables GPs to prescribe community activities for isolated elderly patients and tracks wellbeing improvement - tackling loneliness as seriously as any physical illness.
quests.hint: Lead with the prescription model for social connection.
quests.explanation: Social prescribing treated with clinical seriousness elevates it to evidence-based medicine.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a paediatric health platform tracking developmental milestones with parent input.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform tracks your child's developmental milestones through parent observations and flags any delays to paediatricians early - when intervention is most effective.
quests.hint: Lead with the early flag and the optimal intervention timing.
quests.explanation: Early developmental screening linked to optimal intervention timing is the most compelling paediatric prevention pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an asthma management platform for children using gamified inhaler training.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform teaches children correct inhaler technique through games and tracks real usage - improving adherence and reducing hospitalisations in the most non-compliant age group.
quests.hint: Lead with the non-compliant age group problem.
quests.explanation: Naming children as the most non-compliant inhaler users creates immediate recognition of the clinical gap.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a childhood obesity intervention combining physical activity nutrition and behavioural support.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform combines movement challenges nutrition guidance and family-based behavioural support into an evidence-based childhood obesity intervention that works with the whole family.
quests.hint: Lead with the whole-family approach as the evidence-based differentiator.
quests.explanation: Whole-family involvement is what distinguishes effective childhood obesity programmes from ineffective individual ones.
